+#[tauri::command]
+pub async fn Get(
+	Path: String,
+	Work: tauri::State<'_, std::sync::Arc<Echo::Fn::Job::Work>>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+	crate::Fn::Get::Fn(Path, Work).await
+}
+
+#[tauri::command]
+pub async fn Put(
+	Path: String,
+	Content: String,
+	Work: tauri::State<'_, std::sync::Arc<Echo::Fn::Job::Work>>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+	crate::Fn::Put::Fn(Path, Content, Work).await
+}
